subject: numpy
why: accepted: Zlib is a permissive licence (no copyleft) on code numpy ships; numpy is a hard dependency of modelscan's pickle scanner.

subject: numpy.libs/libgfortran
why: accepted: a GCC runtime library under the GCC Runtime Library Exception, which lets independent code use it without GPL obligations; shipped unmodified inside numpy's wheel.

subject: numpy.libs/libquadmath
why: accepted: an unmodified, dynamically linked LGPL library (the GCC quad-precision runtime) shipped as a separate shared object inside numpy's wheel.

subject: h5py.libs/libhdf5
why: the HDF5 library bundled in h5py's wheel, under the HDF Group's own BSD-style licence (h5py licenses/hdf5.txt), which has no SPDX id on the ADR-0176 list.

subject: h5py.libs/libhdf5_hl
why: HDF5's high-level library, bundled with libhdf5 under the same licence.

subject: python
why: the CPython runtime of the base image (permissive, not copyleft), which modelscan needs to run; PSF-2.0 is not on the ADR-0176 list.
